propwash.creative.footer.read_only: Read only – values can only be changed in creative mode
propwash.creative.intro: The Creative Flight Controller opens up the flight model: every value here applies to flying, the physics itself stays the same. Looks, video system and accessories stay the installed parts. “Save” applies the values to the drone.
propwash.creative.intro.read_only: Editable in creative mode only. You can see the values of this creative drone, copy its code and save it as your own template.
propwash.creative.intro.armed: The drone is armed: saved values take effect once you disarm.
propwash.creative.warnings.none: No notes – the flight model works within its usual range.
propwash.creative.template.choice.tip: Starting values for the editor: the installed parts, every preset, presets from add-ons and your own templates. “Load” replaces all values.
propwash.creative.template.load.tip: Sets every value to the chosen template. Nothing is stored until you press “Save”.
propwash.creative.template.name: Template name
propwash.creative.template.save.tip: Stores the current values as your own template on this computer (config/propwash/creative_templates.json). The same name overwrites.
propwash.creative.template.delete.tip: Deletes the selected template of your own.
propwash.creative.code.copy.tip: Copies every value as a short code (starts with PWD1-) to the clipboard – for sharing in chat or on Discord.
propwash.creative.code.paste.tip: Reads a share code from the clipboard. Values outside the limits are clamped, unknown parts are skipped.
propwash.creative.code.invalid: No valid share code on the clipboard
propwash.creative.base.tip: Every value you do not change yourself comes from this part, including things without a field of their own (cell chemistry, frame shape, stator). “Installed” uses the part in the drone.
propwash.creative.param.frame.mass_g.tip: Weight of the frame without electronics. More mass makes the drone sluggish and needs more thrust.
propwash.creative.param.motor.mass_g.tip: Weight of one motor. Heavy motors far out raise the inertia a lot.
propwash.creative.param.prop.mass_g.tip: Weight of one prop. Heavy props spin up more slowly (motor response).
propwash.creative.param.battery.mass_g.t: Weight of the battery. It sits close to the centre of mass and is often the largest share of the mass.
propwash.creative.param.stack.mass_g.tip: Weight of the flight controller and motor controllers.
propwash.creative.param.video.mass_g.tip: Weight of camera and video transmitter. The video system itself (analog or digital) stays the installed one.
propwash.creative.param.inertia.roll.tip: Moment of inertia around the roll axis. Automatic: computed from masses and positions. Small: twitchy and fast, large: locked-in and slow.
propwash.creative.param.inertia.pitch.ti: Moment of inertia around the pitch axis. Automatic: computed from masses and positions.
propwash.creative.param.inertia.yaw.tip: Moment of inertia around the yaw axis. Large: yaw spins up more slowly.
propwash.creative.param.frame.wheelbase_: Distance between diagonally opposite motors. Moves the motors as long as you do not set them one by one.
propwash.creative.param.prop.diameter_mm: Larger props make much more thrust and torque. The installed props keep their size in the picture.
propwash.creative.param.prop.pitch_in.ti: More pitch: higher top speed, less static thrust.
propwash.creative.param.prop.blades.tip: Number of blades for sound and losses of small props. Thrust and torque come from the two coefficients below.
propwash.creative.param.prop.ct.tip: How much thrust the prop makes per revolution. Higher: more thrust, but it needs power (Cp).
propwash.creative.param.prop.cp.tip: How much torque the prop asks from the motor. Higher: more load, lower rpm, stronger yaw.
propwash.creative.param.motor.kv.tip: Speed per volt. High KV with many cells spins very fast – but it draws current.
propwash.creative.param.motor.resistance: Internal resistance of one motor. Higher: more heat, less power.
propwash.creative.param.motor.max_curren: Current rating of one motor. It also sets the idle current.
propwash.creative.param.battery.cells.ti: Cells in series. More cells: more voltage and rpm. The Creative Flight Controller handles 1–12S.
propwash.creative.param.battery.capacity: How much charge the battery stores. More capacity: longer flight time (change the mass above).
propwash.creative.param.battery.resistan: Higher: stronger voltage sag under load.
propwash.creative.param.battery.c_rating: Continuous rating as a multiple of the capacity.
propwash.creative.param.stack.esc_curren: Above this the motor controller limits the current.
propwash.creative.param.frame.frontal_ar: Area seen from the front. Larger: more drag in forward flight.
propwash.creative.param.frame.side_area_: Area seen from the side. Automatic: estimated from the frontal area.
propwash.creative.param.frame.top_area_c: Area seen from above, it slows climbing, sinking and rotations. Automatic: estimated from the frontal area.
propwash.creative.param.frame.ducts.tip: Rings around the props like on a whoop: a little more thrust, softer bounces, more drag.
propwash.creative.param.frame.impact_tol: From which impact speed a hit counts as a crash (damage).
propwash.creative.param.video.fov_deg.ti: Horizontal field of view of the FPV camera. The creative goggles can use their own field of view.
propwash.creative.param.camera.forward.t: Position of the camera on the frame. Automatic: as on the base frame.
propwash.creative.param.camera.right.tip: Position of the camera across the flight direction.
propwash.creative.param.camera.up.tip: Height of the camera on the frame.
propwash.creative.param.arm.front_left.f: Motor position in mm from the centre of the frame. Once you set a position, the flight model works with free motor positions; each motor stays in its quarter.

propwash.creative.tooltip.auto: Without a value of your own: computed from the other values
propwash.creative.tooltip.base: Without a value of your own: from the base part
propwash.creative.tooltip.reset: Right-click: back to the base or automatic value
propwash.creative.flight.hint: Set rates and PIDs as usual. The derived PIDs adapt to the new values after saving.
propwash.creative.warning.props_overlap: Props overlap (diameter larger than the motor spacing)
propwash.creative.warning.inertia_low: Inertia below a quarter of the automatic value: very twitchy
propwash.creative.warning.inertia_high: Inertia above four times the automatic value: very sluggish
propwash.creative.warning.extreme_thrust: Thrust over 25 times the weight – for experiments only
propwash.creative.warning.over_server_sp: Faster than the server limit of 540 km/h – the server holds it back there

propwash.creative.rejected: These values do not make a valid flight model and were not applied

propwash.guide.scene.creative_drone.desc: Set every value of the flight model freely
propwash.guide.scene.creative_drone.step: The creative inventory holds the Creative Flight Controller. It fits every frame and turns the other parts into a creative drone.
Hold the drone or fly it, then open the configurator: in the “Drone Editor” tab masses, geometry, props, motors and battery are free.
Start from any preset or your own base parts, keep templates and share them as a code. Set rates and PIDs as usual.
Same physics, free values: saved values apply at once, in flight after disarming. Creative drones do not count for leaderboards.
